# Third-Party Notices

## bzip2/libbzip2

The RL-based compression method uses a bzip2-based compression core. Parts of this core are based on the open-source bzip2/libbzip2 implementation originally developed by Julian Seward.

Official project page: https://sourceware.org/bzip2/  
Official documentation: https://sourceware.org/bzip2/manual/manual.html

The original copyright and license notices are preserved in the relevant source files.
